name: The Fisherman's Forever Faith
detailed_description:
Meet your chill desktop buddy! This laid-back fisherman hangs out on your screen, casting lines and catching fish while you work or study. Features lofi tunes, a digital diary, fish collecting, and relaxing idle gameplay right on your desktop.

Your Desktop's Chillest Fishing Buddy!

Turn your workspace into a cozy place with The Fisherman's Forever Faith. It's not just another idle game—it's like having a calm fishing friend who's always there, sharing little thoughts about life and the perfect catch while you get stuff done.

🎣 Your Fishing Buddy in Action

If you're tired of fast-paced games, you're going to love the fisherman's rhythm. Some days luck is on his side and he'll pull in dozens of fish back-to-back. Other days? Well, that's fishing for you—sometimes the fish just aren't biting. But that's part of the charm. Pure chill vibes with zero pressure.

📓 Digital Diary That Actually Works

Easy Diary Features: Write whatever you want with nice formatting, organize with colored tags, and actually find your old entries with search.

Daily Wisdom: Your fishing buddy drops little life observations and fishing thoughts—nothing preachy, just nice stuff to read.

Your Space: Jot down ideas, goals, or random thoughts in a diary that feels good to use.

💬 Stories & Wisdom from the Water

Daily Wisdom: Your fishing buddy drops little life observations and fishing thoughts—nothing preachy, just nice stuff to read.

The Old Fisherman's Stories: Between catches, he loves sharing memories from his years by the water. Tales of the biggest fish that got away, storms he's weathered, quiet mornings when the lake was like glass, and life lessons learned from a lifetime of fishing. Each story feels like sitting by a campfire with your grandfather, hearing about the good old days. Sometimes funny, sometimes touching, always genuine.

🌅 Always Changing Scenery

The view keeps things interesting:

  • Day/Night: The sky follows your computer's real time—so when it's night for you, it's night for the fisherman too

  • Weather Changes: Light drizzle, heavy rain, thick fog, or bright sunshine—the weather keeps things interesting

  • Different Seasons: Five different lakeside views that switch up

  • Moving Water: Gentle waves and reflections that look alive

🎣 Fishing That Makes Sense

7 Different Hooks: Each one works differently—some are faster, some catch rarer fish. But here's the thing—hooks can break or get lost! When that happens, the Old Fisherman takes it as a perfect excuse for a well-deserved nap while you replace his gear. It's a nice little reminder that even in a chill game, sometimes you need to step in and help out your buddy.

Fish Collection: Keep track of everything you've caught

Daily Luck: Some days the fish bite more than others

Gear Stuff: Buy new hooks, sell old ones, figure out what works best

🎵 Perfect Background Vibes

Handpicked lofi music that help you focus without being distracting with gentle water and rain sounds when you want them

🎣 Plenty Of Stories

🌟 What You Get

  • Chill Fishing Friend who's always hanging out with good vibes

  • Works on Your Desktop - float it anywhere on your monitor

  • Actually Useful Diary with tags and search that works

  • 47 Fish to Collect from common to super rare

  • Scenery That Changes with day, night, and weather

  • Cozy Pixel Art that looks great without being flashy

  • Make It Yours - adjust whatever you want

  • Multiple Languages so everyone can enjoy it

Perfect For: Students who want something calm while studying • People working from home who need good background vibes • Anyone who likes collecting stuff • Fans of pixel art and nature • People who want to chill out without getting bored

short_description: Meet The Old Fisherman, your chill desktop companion! Watch him cast his line and reel in amazing catches - from tiny minnows to legendary fish - while you work, study, or relax. Features lofi music, digital diary, fish collecting, it's a tiny game that lives anywhere on your desktop.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 @ 3.2 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card or integrated audio

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 or later
  • Processor: Both
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 2GB VRAM for optimal performance
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
